narrative.label: Our commitment
narrative.title: Markets create wealth. We help it reach further.
narrative.lead: {{brand}} was built on the belief that open markets create opportunity. Charity is how we extend that opportunity to people the markets too often leave behind.
paragraphs: Every campaign on this page is vetted by our partnerships team and an independent NGO partner before it goes live. We verify the organisation, the budget and the intended outcome, and we publish progress as funds are deployed.
Because donations move on rails we already operate, there are no card fees, no FX spreads and no intermediaries skimming the top. The amount you give is the amount that arrives.
This is just the beginning. As the community grows, so does our capacity to fund clean water, education, healthcare and emergency relief at scale.

faq.account1: How do I change my password?
faq.account1Answer: Go to Profile → Personal Settings → Login Password to change your password.
faq.account2: What if I forgot my password?
faq.account2Answer: Click "Forgot password" on the login page and reset it via email verification.
faq.trade1: How do I place a trade?
faq.trade1Answer: After depositing, go to the trading page, select a trading pair, enter the amount and price, then place your order.
faq.trade2Answer: Fees vary by trading pair. Please check the fee schedule for details.
faq.deposit1Answer: Go to Assets → Deposit, select a currency, then copy the deposit address to transfer.
faq.deposit2Answer: Once approved, withdrawals usually arrive within 10–30 minutes.
faq.security1: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
faq.security1Answer: Go to Profile → Personal Settings → Two-Factor Auth to set it up.
faq.security2: What if my account is compromised?
faq.security2Answer: Contact customer support immediately to freeze your account and provide supporting documentation.
